page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture GPU-accelerated server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs, consisting of 48 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 736.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.67 GB of memory per core. Acceleration is driven by eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, delivering a combined 256 GB of VRAM. This server operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage options.

Performance benchmarks indicate a significant divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is 1104.49, which falls into the bottom 25% tier. In contrast, the multi-core CPU performance is highly robust, scoring 70674.73 in stress-ng and placing in the top 25% tier. This performance profile indicates that workloads must be highly parallelized to utilize the CPU architecture effectively. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Given the high density of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and substantial system memory, this instance represents a significant resource commitment. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for massive parallel processing tasks where GPU acceleration is the primary driver, offsetting the lower single-core CPU performance. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, high-performance computing, and complex scientific simulations that can utilize the 256 GB of total VRAM and 96 vCPUs.
